dedupe_keys.name: electric power substations in myanmar 2025 mimu and cde myanmar non authoritative point layer with voltage and operating status

description: The Myanmar Information Management Unit (MIMU), the UN-supported information service for humanitarian and development actors, publishes a point layer of electricity substations on its GeoNode. Contents: 319 approximate centre-point locations of transmission and distribution substations as of 2025, each with a facility code, a non-authoritative English name, facility type, operating status and voltage level in kV (for example 230 kV primary substations). Producer: CDE Myanmar for MIMU, using public reference maps of the Ministry of Electric Power, OpenStreetMap, local knowledge and high-resolution satellite imagery. Coverage: the whole of Myanmar. Format and access: GeoNode layer with WMS and WFS services, so GeoJSON, shapefile and CSV can be downloaded without registration; the layer carries the date 12 August 2025. Licence: the layer page states no licence; MIMU products are shared for humanitarian and development use with attribution. Caveats: positions are approximate and names are not official; lines between substations are not published, so the grid topology must be built from other sources such as OpenStreetMap; operating status may have changed since the 2021 crisis. Simulation uses: building a rough transmission network model with the power plant layer, exposure of substations to cyclones, floods and earthquakes, and planning humanitarian power supply. Related records: MIMU power plants and hydropower dams (data-mimu-myanmar-power-plants-and-hydropower-dams) come from the same producer.
